name: Feature list
description: A list of short features, each a title and a line of text marked with an icon or a check, under an optional heading and intro. Lighter than a card grid: no images, no links.

columns.description: Features per row on wide screens; one on phones, two on tablets.

style.description: icon: each feature's own icon in a tinted badge. check: the same check mark before every feature. list: an icon list — one column of body-size lines, each after its icon, titles as text rather than headings (columns is ignored).

items.label: Features

title.label: Title
title.description: The feature, in a few words.

icon.label: Icon
icon.description: The kit icon shown with the icon style; check when absent.

items.description: The features, in order (Elementor icon list or icon boxes without images, Gutenberg list of features, Divi blurbs with icons).

bare.description: Only the list, with no section of its own; a split section uses it under its text.

titleLevel.description: With `bare`: the item titles' heading level (the section's plus one).

measured.description: The source section's measured style (MeasuredStyle): frame width, padding, fill, image, columns per width, gap, text tone, radius, minimum height — all in pixels. Absent, the site's tokens; present, it wins over tone and columns. Values that are not a number, a colour or a known keyword are dropped.

color.description: Fill colour: hex, rgb(a) or hsl(a).

image.description: Background image address (http(s) or root-relative), drawn behind the content.

overlay.description: Colour or linear/radial gradient laid over the image or the fill.

size.description: cover, contain or auto; anything else draws as cover.

position.description: One or two of center/top/bottom/left/right or percentages.

columns.description: Item columns at 390 (base), 768 (md) and 1280 (lg) px; a missing width follows the narrower one.

tone.description: What the text is set for: dark = light text on a dark band. Without it, a fill's own lightness decides.

align.description: Where the heading and lead sit; read by a component whose own align is not set.

id.description: Anchor id of the section; the heading gets `<id>-title`.

a11y: A list; icons are decorative (aria-hidden), the title and text carry the meaning. Each title is an <h3> under the section's <h2>, or an <h2> when the section has no heading (the list style's are plain text). The section is labelled by its heading.

pattern.summary: repeated icon + short title + line of text
